[[File:Monsail.jpg|thumb|250px|Dark skinwings soar in the skies of Trinta above [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] fighting with a [[monsail]].]]

The term '''skinwing''' referred to various winged species that flew using membranes of skin instead of feathers, including species on [[Trinta]]<ref name="DoE">
''[[Domain of Evil]]''</ref> and [[Goroth Prime/Legends|Goroth Prime]]. The skinwings on Trinta were corrupted by the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and became known as '''dark skinwings'''.
